prompt: (a) 将 $f(x)=x/(\sqrt{1+3x}-1)$ 作图，估计 $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+3x}-1}$。(b) 列出 $x$ 接近 $0$ 时 $f(x)$ 的数值表，猜测极限。(c) 用极限定律证明猜测正确。

steps.title: 观察图像 (a)
steps.body: 定义域为 $x\ge-1/3$ 且 $x\ne0$。解答图在 $x=0$ 处留下空心点；从两侧靠近该点时，高度约为 $0.667$，据此估计极限为 $2/3$。

steps.title: 乘以共轭 (c)
steps.body: 当 $x\ne0$ 时，$\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+3x}-1}=\frac{x(\sqrt{1+3x}+1)}{(1+3x)-1}=\frac{\sqrt{1+3x}+1}{3}$。只在去心邻域约去 $x$，无须定义原函数在 $0$ 处的值。

steps.title: 应用极限定律 (c)
steps.body: 由和、常数倍及平方根定律，$\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=(\sqrt{1+3\cdot0}+1)/3=2/3$，证实图像和数值的猜测。

en.prompt: (a) Estimate the value of $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+3x}-1}$ by graphing the function $f(x)=x/(\sqrt{1+3x}-1)$. (b) Make a table of values of $f(x)$ for $x$ close to $0$ and guess the value of the limit. (c) Use the Limit Laws to prove that your guess is correct.

steps.title: Read the graph (a)
steps.body: The domain is $x\ge-1/3$ with $x\ne0$. The solution graph leaves an open point at $x=0$; from either side its height approaches about $0.667$, suggesting a limit of $2/3$.

steps.title: Make a table (b)
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, evaluate the equivalent expression $(\sqrt{1+3x}+1)/3$ to avoid subtracting nearly equal numbers: $\begin{array}{r|r}x&f(x)\\\hline -0.1 & 0.6122200\\-0.01 & 0.6616286\\-0.001 & 0.6661663\\0.001 & 0.6671663\\0.01 & 0.6716297\\0.1 & 0.7133918\end{array}$. Values on both sides approach $0.666666\ldots$.

steps.title: Rationalize (c)
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+3x}-1}=\frac{x(\sqrt{1+3x}+1)}{(1+3x)-1}=\frac{\sqrt{1+3x}+1}{3}$. Cancel $x$ only in a punctured neighborhood; the original function need not have a value at $0$.

steps.title: Apply the Limit Laws (c)
steps.body: The sum, constant-multiple, and square-root laws give $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=(\sqrt{1+3\cdot0}+1)/3=2/3$, confirming the graphical and numerical estimates.

en.answer: (a) About $0.667$; (b) conjecture $2/3$; (c) the exact limit is $2/3$.

prompt: (a) 用 $f(x)=\frac{\sqrt{3+x}-\sqrt3}{x}$ 的图像估计 $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)$，保留两位小数。(b) 用数值表估计极限，保留四位小数。(c) 用极限定律求精确极限。

steps.title: 读图 (a)
steps.body: 函数在 $x\ge-3$ 且 $x\ne0$ 上有定义。解答图显示两侧曲线在 $x=0$ 附近趋近 $0.289$；保留两位小数得到 $0.29$。

steps.title: 共轭化简 (c)
steps.body: 对 $x\ne0$，$\frac{\sqrt{3+x}-\sqrt3}{x}=\frac{(3+x)-3}{x(\sqrt{3+x}+\sqrt3)}=\frac1{\sqrt{3+x}+\sqrt3}$。

steps.title: 求精确极限 (c)
steps.body: 化简后的分母极限为 $2\sqrt3\ne0$，商与根式定律给出 $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=1/(2\sqrt3)=\sqrt3/6$。

en.prompt: (a) Use a graph of $f(x)=\frac{\sqrt{3+x}-\sqrt3}{x}$ to estimate the value of $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)$ to two decimal places. (b) Use a table of values of $f(x)$ to estimate the limit to four decimal places. (c) Use the Limit Laws to find the exact value of the limit.

steps.title: Read the graph (a)
steps.body: The function is defined for $x\ge-3$ with $x\ne0$. The solution graph approaches about $0.289$ on both sides of $x=0$, giving $0.29$ to two decimal places.

steps.title: Make a table (b)
steps.body: Use the equivalent expression $1/(\sqrt{3+x}+\sqrt3)$ to calculate: $\begin{array}{r|r}x&f(x)\\\hline -0.01 & 0.2889161\\-0.001 & 0.2886992\\-0.0001 & 0.2886775\\0.0001 & 0.2886727\\0.001 & 0.2886511\\0.01 & 0.2884350\end{array}$. Both sides approach $0.288675\ldots$, or $0.2887$ to four decimal places.

steps.title: Rationalize (c)
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $\frac{\sqrt{3+x}-\sqrt3}{x}=\frac{(3+x)-3}{x(\sqrt{3+x}+\sqrt3)}=\frac1{\sqrt{3+x}+\sqrt3}$.

steps.title: Find the exact limit (c)
steps.body: The simplified denominator tends to $2\sqrt3\ne0$. The quotient and root laws give $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=1/(2\sqrt3)=\sqrt3/6$.

prompt: 用夹逼定理证明 $\lim_{x\to0}(x^2\cos20\pi x)=0$。在同一坐标系中画出 $f(x)=-x^2$、$g(x)=x^2\cos20\pi x$ 和 $h(x)=x^2$ 以说明结论。

steps.title: 找到上下界
steps.body: 由 $-1\le\cos20\pi x\le1$，乘以非负的 $x^2$ 得 $-x^2\le x^2\cos20\pi x\le x^2$，即 $f(x)\le g(x)\le h(x)$。

steps.title: 两边趋向同一值
steps.body: 多项式极限定律给出 $\lim_{x\to0}(-x^2)=0=\lim_{x\to0}x^2$。夹逼定理因此给出 $\lim_{x\to0}g(x)=0$。

steps.title: 解释同屏图像
steps.body: 解答图中，振荡曲线 $g$ 始终夹在两条抛物线之间。虽然余弦在区间内振荡，两条包络曲线都在原点收拢，振幅不超过 $x^2$。

en.prompt: Use the Squeeze Theorem to show that $\lim_{x\to0}(x^2\cos20\pi x)=0$. Illustrate by graphing the functions $f(x)=-x^2$, $g(x)=x^2\cos20\pi x$, and $h(x)=x^2$ on the same screen.

steps.title: Find bounding functions
steps.body: Because $-1\le\cos20\pi x\le1$, multiplying by the nonnegative number $x^2$ gives $-x^2\le x^2\cos20\pi x\le x^2$, or $f(x)\le g(x)\le h(x)$.

steps.title: Both bounds approach the same value
steps.body: The polynomial limit laws give $\lim_{x\to0}(-x^2)=0=\lim_{x\to0}x^2$. The Squeeze Theorem therefore gives $\lim_{x\to0}g(x)=0$.

steps.title: Interpret the combined graph
steps.body: In the solution graph, the oscillating curve $g$ stays between the two parabolas. Although the cosine oscillates over the interval, both envelopes meet at the origin and its amplitude is at most $x^2$.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to0}x^2\cos20\pi x=0$.

prompt: 用夹逼定理证明 $\lim_{x\to0}\sqrt{x^3+x^2}\,\sin\frac{\pi}{x}=0$。按夹逼定理中的记号，将函数 $f,g,h$ 画在同一坐标系中以说明结论。

steps.title: 确定振幅和定义域
steps.body: 根号仅包含 $x^3+x^2$。在 $x\ge-1$ 上，$\sqrt{x^3+x^2}=|x|\sqrt{1+x}\ge0$；原振荡函数还要求 $x\ne0$。设 $g(x)=\sqrt{x^3+x^2}\sin(\pi/x)$。

steps.title: 构造夹逼函数
steps.body: 因为 $-1\le\sin(\pi/x)\le1$，令 $f(x)=-\sqrt{x^3+x^2}$、$h(x)=\sqrt{x^3+x^2}$，则对邻近 $0$ 的 $x\ne0$ 有 $f(x)\le g(x)\le h(x)$。

steps.title: 证明包络极限
steps.body: 从左侧 $|x|=-x\to0$，从右侧 $|x|=x\to0$，所以 $\lim_{x\to0}|x|=0$。又因 $1+x\to1>0$，平方根定律给出 $\sqrt{1+x}\to1$。由积定律，$\sqrt{x^3+x^2}=|x|\sqrt{1+x}\to0\cdot1=0$。因此上下界都趋零，夹逼定理得到 $\lim_{x\to0}g(x)=0$。

steps.title: 解释图像
steps.body: 解答图显示 $g$ 在两条包络线内振荡。越接近 $0$，振荡频率越高，但振幅 $|x|\sqrt{1+x}$ 越小；空心点表示 $g(0)$ 未定义。

answer: 极限为 $0$；上下夹逼函数为 $\pm\sqrt{x^3+x^2}$。

en.prompt: Use the Squeeze Theorem to show that $\lim_{x\to0}\sqrt{x^3+x^2}\,\sin\frac{\pi}{x}=0$. Illustrate by graphing the functions $f$, $g$, and $h$ (in the notation of the Squeeze Theorem) on the same screen.

steps.title: Identify the amplitude and domain
steps.body: The radical contains only $x^3+x^2$. For $x\ge-1$, $\sqrt{x^3+x^2}=|x|\sqrt{1+x}\ge0$; the oscillating function also requires $x\ne0$. Let $g(x)=\sqrt{x^3+x^2}\sin(\pi/x)$.

steps.title: Construct the bounds
steps.body: Since $-1\le\sin(\pi/x)\le1$, let $f(x)=-\sqrt{x^3+x^2}$ and $h(x)=\sqrt{x^3+x^2}$. Then $f(x)\le g(x)\le h(x)$ for nonzero $x$ near $0$.

steps.title: Find the envelope limits
steps.body: On the left $|x|=-x\to0$, and on the right $|x|=x\to0$, so $\lim_{x\to0}|x|=0$. Since $1+x\to1>0$, the square-root law gives $\sqrt{1+x}\to1$. The product law then gives $\sqrt{x^3+x^2}=|x|\sqrt{1+x}\to0\cdot1=0$. Both bounds therefore tend to zero, and the Squeeze Theorem gives $\lim_{x\to0}g(x)=0$.

steps.title: Interpret the graph
steps.body: The solution graph shows $g$ oscillating between its envelopes. Closer to $0$, the frequency increases but the amplitude $|x|\sqrt{1+x}$ decreases. An open point marks the undefined value $g(0)$.

en.answer: The limit is $0$; the bounding functions are $\pm\sqrt{x^3+x^2}$.

prompt: 若对 $x\ge0$ 有 $4x-9\le f(x)\le x^2-4x+7$，求 $\lim_{x\to4}f(x)$。

steps.title: 计算下界极限
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to4}(4x-9)=4\cdot4-9=7$。点 $4$ 附近的小区间满足 $x\ge0$，故所给不等式在该邻域有效。

steps.title: 计算上界并夹逼
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to4}(x^2-4x+7)=16-16+7=7$。上下界的极限一致，由夹逼定理得 $\lim_{x\to4}f(x)=7$。

en.prompt: If $4x-9\le f(x)\le x^2-4x+7$ for $x\ge0$, find $\lim_{x\to4}f(x)$.

steps.title: Evaluate the lower bound
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to4}(4x-9)=4\cdot4-9=7$. A small interval around $4$ lies in $x\ge0$, so the given inequalities apply there.

steps.title: Evaluate the upper bound and squeeze
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to4}(x^2-4x+7)=16-16+7=7$. Since both bounding limits agree, the Squeeze Theorem gives $\lim_{x\to4}f(x)=7$.

prompt: 若对所有 $x$ 有 $2x\le g(x)\le x^4-x^2+2$，求 $\lim_{x\to1}g(x)$。

steps.title: 计算两个边界极限
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}2x=2$；$\lim_{x\to1}(x^4-x^2+2)=1-1+2=2$，两个多项式都可直接代入。

steps.title: 应用夹逼定理
steps.body: 所给不等式在 $1$ 的邻域中成立，且上下界都趋于 $2$，因此 $g(x)$ 也趋于 $2$。

en.prompt: If $2x\le g(x)\le x^4-x^2+2$ for all $x$, evaluate $\lim_{x\to1}g(x)$.

steps.title: Evaluate the two bounds
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to1}2x=2$, and $\lim_{x\to1}(x^4-x^2+2)=1-1+2=2$. Both are polynomial limits evaluated by substitution.

steps.title: Apply the Squeeze Theorem
steps.body: The given inequalities hold near $1$, and both bounds approach $2$, so $g(x)$ also approaches $2$.

prompt: 证明 $\lim_{x\to0}x^4\cos\frac2x=0$。

steps.title: 用余弦的有界性
steps.body: 对于 $x\ne0$，$-1\le\cos(2/x)\le1$。乘以 $x^4\ge0$ 后得到 $-x^4\le x^4\cos(2/x)\le x^4$。

steps.title: 让上下界同时趋零
steps.body: 当 $x\to0$ 时，$-x^4$ 与 $x^4$ 都趋于 $0$。由夹逼定理，原函数的极限为 $0$，无需余弦因子本身存在极限。

en.prompt: Prove that $\lim_{x\to0}x^4\cos\frac2x=0$.

steps.title: Use the bounded cosine
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $-1\le\cos(2/x)\le1$. Multiplication by $x^4\ge0$ gives $-x^4\le x^4\cos(2/x)\le x^4$.

steps.title: Let both bounds tend to zero
steps.body: As $x\to0$, both $-x^4$ and $x^4$ tend to $0$. The Squeeze Theorem gives a limit of $0$ for the product, without requiring the cosine factor to have a limit.

prompt: 证明 $\lim_{x\to0^+}\sqrt{x}\,e^{\sin(\pi/x)}=0$。

steps.title: 界定指数因子
steps.body: $-1\le\sin(\pi/x)\le1$，指数函数递增，故 $e^{-1}\le e^{\sin(\pi/x)}\le e$。对于 $x>0$，乘以 $\sqrt{x}$ 不改变不等号方向。

steps.title: 在右侧夹逼
steps.body: $\sqrt{x}/e\le\sqrt{x}\,e^{\sin(\pi/x)}\le e\sqrt{x}$。根式在右侧趋零：任给正数 $\eta$，只要 $0<x<\eta^2$ 就有 $0<\sqrt{x}<\eta$。所以两侧夹逼函数都趋于 $0$，由单侧夹逼定理得到结论。

en.prompt: Prove that $\lim_{x\to0^+}\sqrt{x}\,e^{\sin(\pi/x)}=0$.

steps.title: Bound the exponential factor
steps.body: $-1\le\sin(\pi/x)\le1$, and the exponential is increasing, so $e^{-1}\le e^{\sin(\pi/x)}\le e$. For $x>0$, multiplication by $\sqrt{x}$ preserves the inequalities.

steps.title: Squeeze from the right
steps.body: $\sqrt{x}/e\le\sqrt{x}\,e^{\sin(\pi/x)}\le e\sqrt{x}$. The square root tends to zero from the right: for any positive $\eta$, $0<x<\eta^2$ implies $0<\sqrt{x}<\eta$. Thus both bounding functions tend to $0$, and the one-sided Squeeze Theorem proves the result.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to3}(2x+|x-3|)$；若不存在，说明原因。

steps.title: 比较单侧极限
steps.body: 左极限为 $3+3=6$；右极限为 $3\cdot3-3=6$。两者相等，故双侧极限为 $6$。

en.prompt: Find $\lim_{x\to3}(2x+|x-3|)$, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.

steps.title: Remove the absolute value on each side
Compare one-sided limits
steps.body: The left limit is $3+3=6$, and the right limit is $3\cdot3-3=6$. Since they agree, the two-sided limit is $6$.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to-6}\frac{2x+12}{|x+6|}$；若不存在，说明原因。
answer: 不存在；左极限为 $-2$，右极限为 $2$。

en.prompt: Find $\lim_{x\to-6}\frac{2x+12}{|x+6|}$, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.

steps.title: Simplify on each side
steps.body: $2x+12=2(x+6)$. For $x>-6$, the quotient is $2$. For $x<-6$, $|x+6|=-(x+6)$ and the quotient is $-2$.

steps.title: The one-sided limits differ
steps.body: $\lim_{x\to-6^-}\frac{2x+12}{|x+6|}=-2$, whereas $\lim_{x\to-6^+}\frac{2x+12}{|x+6|}=2$. Thus the two-sided limit does not exist.

en.answer: Does not exist; the left limit is $-2$ and the right limit is $2$.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to0.5^-}\frac{2x-1}{|2x^3-x^2|}$；若不存在，说明原因。

en.prompt: Find $\lim_{x\to0.5^-}\frac{2x-1}{|2x^3-x^2|}$, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.

steps.title: Cancel and substitute
steps.body: In this punctured left neighborhood, $\frac{2x-1}{|2x^3-x^2|}=-1/x^2$. The limit is therefore $-1/(0.5)^2=-4$.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to-2}\frac{2-|x|}{2+x}$；若不存在，说明原因。

steps.title: 使用整个邻域的符号
steps.body: 在 $-2$ 的充分小邻域内，两侧的 $x$ 都为负数，故 $|x|=-x$，分子变成 $2+x$。

steps.title: 在去心邻域约去
steps.body: 对于该邻域内 $x\ne-2$，$\frac{2-|x|}{2+x}=\frac{2+x}{2+x}=1$，所以极限为 $1$；原式在 $x=-2$ 未定义不影响极限。

en.prompt: Find $\lim_{x\to-2}\frac{2-|x|}{2+x}$, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.

steps.title: Use the sign throughout a neighborhood
steps.body: In a sufficiently small neighborhood of $-2$, $x$ is negative on both sides. Thus $|x|=-x$ and the numerator becomes $2+x$.

steps.title: Cancel in the punctured neighborhood
steps.body: For $x\ne-2$ in that neighborhood, $\frac{2-|x|}{2+x}=\frac{2+x}{2+x}=1$. The limit is $1$ even though the original expression is undefined at $x=-2$.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to0^-}\left(\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}\right)$；若不存在，说明原因。

steps.title: 在左侧处理绝对值
steps.body: 当 $x<0$ 时，$|x|=-x$，所以 $\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}=\frac1x-\frac1{-x}=2/x$。

steps.title: 描述无界行为
steps.body: 当负数 $x$ 越来越接近 $0$，$2/x$ 无界地减小。因此不存在有限实数极限；用无穷极限记号写为 $-\infty$。

answer: 无有限极限；表达式趋于 $-\infty$。

en.prompt: Find $\lim_{x\to0^-}\left(\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}\right)$, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.

steps.title: Remove the absolute value on the left
steps.body: For $x<0$, $|x|=-x$, so $\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}=\frac1x-\frac1{-x}=2/x$.

steps.title: Describe the unbounded behavior
steps.body: As negative $x$ approaches $0$, $2/x$ decreases without bound. There is no finite real limit; in infinite-limit notation it is $-\infty$.

en.answer: No finite limit; the expression tends to $-\infty$.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to0^+}\left(\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}\right)$；若不存在，说明原因。

steps.title: 在右侧化简整个表达式
steps.body: 当 $x>0$ 时，$|x|=x$，所以 $\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}=1/x-1/x=0$。先化简，不把两个无穷量当作有限极限相减。

steps.title: 取常数极限
steps.body: 表达式在整个右侧去心邻域恒等于 $0$，故右极限为 $0$。

en.prompt: Find $\lim_{x\to0^+}\left(\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}\right)$, if it exists. If the limit does not exist, explain why.

steps.title: Simplify the whole expression on the right
steps.body: For $x>0$, $|x|=x$, so $\frac1x-\frac1{|x|}=1/x-1/x=0$. Simplify first rather than subtracting two unbounded terms as if they had finite limits.

steps.title: Take the constant limit
steps.body: The expression equals $0$ throughout the punctured right neighborhood, so its right-hand limit is $0$.

prompt: 符号函数 $\operatorname{sgn}x$ 定义为：$x<0$ 时取 $-1$，$x=0$ 时取 $0$，$x>0$ 时取 $1$。(a) 画出图像。(b) 求下列极限，或解释为何不存在：(i) $\lim_{x\to0^+}\operatorname{sgn}x$；(ii) $\lim_{x\to0^-}\operatorname{sgn}x$；(iii) $\lim_{x\to0}\operatorname{sgn}x$；(iv) $\lim_{x\to0}|\operatorname{sgn}x|$。

steps.title: 画分段图 (a)
steps.body: 在 $x<0$ 画水平射线 $y=-1$，在 $x>0$ 画水平射线 $y=1$，并在 $(0,-1)$、$(0,1)$ 画空心点；在 $(0,0)$ 画实心点。解答图展示这些端点。

steps.title: 分别求单侧极限 (b.i–ii)
steps.body: 右侧函数恒为 $1$，故 (i) 为 $1$；左侧函数恒为 $-1$，故 (ii) 为 $-1$。

steps.title: 检查双侧极限 (b.iii)
steps.body: 因为左、右极限 $-1$ 和 $1$ 不相等，(iii) 不存在。函数值 $\operatorname{sgn}0=0$ 不能改变这个结论。

steps.title: 取绝对值 (b.iv)
steps.body: 对所有 $x\ne0$，$|\operatorname{sgn}x|=1$，因此 (iv) 的双侧极限为 $1$。

en.prompt: The signum (or sign) function, denoted by $\operatorname{sgn}$, is defined by $\operatorname{sgn}x=-1$ if $x<0$, $0$ if $x=0$, and $1$ if $x>0$. (a) Sketch the graph of this function. (b) Find each of the following limits or explain why it does not exist: (i) $\lim_{x\to0^+}\operatorname{sgn}x$; (ii) $\lim_{x\to0^-}\operatorname{sgn}x$; (iii) $\lim_{x\to0}\operatorname{sgn}x$; (iv) $\lim_{x\to0}|\operatorname{sgn}x|$.

steps.title: Sketch the pieces (a)
steps.body: Draw the horizontal ray $y=-1$ for $x<0$ and $y=1$ for $x>0$, with open points at $(0,-1)$ and $(0,1)$. Place a filled point at $(0,0)$. These endpoints appear in the solution graph.

steps.title: Find the one-sided limits (b.i–ii)
steps.body: The function equals $1$ on the right, so (i) is $1$. It equals $-1$ on the left, so (ii) is $-1$.

steps.title: Check the two-sided limit (b.iii)
steps.body: The one-sided limits $-1$ and $1$ differ, so (iii) does not exist. The value $\operatorname{sgn}0=0$ does not change this conclusion.

steps.title: Take the absolute value (b.iv)
steps.body: For every $x\ne0$, $|\operatorname{sgn}x|=1$, so the two-sided limit in (iv) is $1$.

en.answer: (a) See the solution graph; (b) (i) $1$, (ii) $-1$, (iii) does not exist, (iv) $1$.

steps.title: 比较两侧 (b)
steps.body: 左极限 $2$ 与右极限 $1$ 不相等，故双侧极限不存在，虽然 $f(1)=1$。

answer: (a) 左极限 $2$，右极限 $1$；(b) 不存在；(c) 图见解析。

en.prompt: Let $f(x)=x^2+1$ if $x<1$, and $f(x)=(x-2)^2$ if $x\ge1$. (a) Find $\lim_{x\to1^-}f(x)$ and $\lim_{x\to1^+}f(x)$. (b) Does $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)$ exist? (c) Sketch the graph of $f$.

steps.title: Use the formula on each side (a)
steps.body: Approaching $1$ from the left uses $x^2+1$, giving $1^2+1=2$. Approaching from the right uses $(x-2)^2$, giving $(1-2)^2=1$.

steps.title: Compare the sides (b)
steps.body: The left limit $2$ and right limit $1$ differ, so the two-sided limit does not exist, although $f(1)=1$.

steps.title: Mark the graph endpoints (c)
steps.body: Plot $y=x^2+1$ for $x<1$ with an open point at $(1,2)$. Plot $y=(x-2)^2$ for $x\ge1$ with a filled point at $(1,1)$ and vertex $(2,0)$.

en.answer: (a) Left limit $2$, right limit $1$; (b) does not exist; (c) see the solution graph.

prompt: 设 $g(x)=\frac{x^2+x-6}{|x-2|}$。(a) 求 (i) $\lim_{x\to2^+}g(x)$，(ii) $\lim_{x\to2^-}g(x)$。(b) $\lim_{x\to2}g(x)$ 是否存在？(c) 画出 $g$ 的图像。

steps.title: 计算单侧极限 (a)
steps.body: (i) 从右侧使用 $x+3$，极限为 $5$；(ii) 从左侧使用 $-(x+3)$，极限为 $-5$。

steps.title: 比较并作图 (b–c)
steps.body: 单侧极限不同，所以 (b) 不存在。(c) 左侧画直线 $y=-x-3$，端点 $(2,-5)$ 为空心；右侧画 $y=x+3$，端点 $(2,5)$ 为空心。两个空心点之间不连接。

en.prompt: Let $g(x)=\frac{x^2+x-6}{|x-2|}$. (a) Find (i) $\lim_{x\to2^+}g(x)$ and (ii) $\lim_{x\to2^-}g(x)$. (b) Does $\lim_{x\to2}g(x)$ exist? (c) Sketch the graph of $g$.

steps.title: Factor and split into pieces
steps.body: $x^2+x-6=(x+3)(x-2)$. For $x>2$, $g(x)=x+3$. For $x<2$, $g(x)=-(x+3)$. The original function is undefined at $x=2$.

steps.title: Evaluate the one-sided limits (a)
steps.body: (i) On the right use $x+3$, giving a limit of $5$. (ii) On the left use $-(x+3)$, giving a limit of $-5$.

steps.title: Compare and sketch (b–c)
steps.body: The one-sided limits differ, so (b) does not exist. For (c), plot $y=-x-3$ on the left with an open endpoint at $(2,-5)$, and $y=x+3$ on the right with an open endpoint at $(2,5)$. Do not connect the two open points.

en.answer: (a.i) $5$; (a.ii) $-5$; (b) does not exist; (c) see the solution graph.

steps.title: 检查 $x=1$ 附近 (a.i–iii)
steps.body: (i) 左侧公式为 $x$，极限为 $1$。右侧公式为 $2-x^2$，极限也为 $2-1=1$，所以 (ii) 双侧极限为 $1$。但 (iii) 根据单点定义 $g(1)=3$；函数值可以与极限不同。

steps.title: 检查 $x=2$ 附近 (a.iv–vi)
steps.body: (iv) 左侧用 $2-x^2$ 得 $2-4=-2$。(v) 右侧用 $x-3$ 得 $2-3=-1$。因此 (vi) 左右不相等，双侧极限不存在。

en.prompt: Let $g(x)=x$ if $x<1$, $3$ if $x=1$, $2-x^2$ if $1<x\le2$, and $x-3$ if $x>2$. (a) Evaluate each of the following, if it exists: (i) $\lim_{x\to1^-}g(x)$; (ii) $\lim_{x\to1}g(x)$; (iii) $g(1)$; (iv) $\lim_{x\to2^-}g(x)$; (v) $\lim_{x\to2^+}g(x)$; (vi) $\lim_{x\to2}g(x)$. (b) Sketch the graph of $g$.

steps.title: Examine $x=1$ (a.i–iii)
steps.body: (i) The left-hand formula is $x$, so the limit is $1$. The right-hand formula is $2-x^2$, whose limit is also $2-1=1$; thus (ii) the two-sided limit is $1$. However, (iii) the single-point definition gives $g(1)=3$. The value can differ from the limit.

steps.title: Examine $x=2$ (a.iv–vi)
steps.body: (iv) From the left, $2-x^2$ gives $2-4=-2$. (v) From the right, $x-3$ gives $2-3=-1$. Therefore (vi) the one-sided limits disagree and the two-sided limit does not exist.

steps.title: Sketch the pieces and isolated value (b)
steps.body: Draw $y=x$ for $x<1$, $y=2-x^2$ for $1<x\le2$, and $y=x-3$ for $x>2$. Mark $(1,1)$ open and $(1,3)$ filled; mark $(2,-2)$ filled and $(2,-1)$ open.

en.answer: (a) (i) $1$, (ii) $1$, (iii) $3$, (iv) $-2$, (v) $-1$, (vi) does not exist; (b) see the solution graph.

prompt: (a) 记 $\lfloor x\rfloor$ 为例题 10 定义的最大整数函数，求 (i) $\lim_{x\to-2^+}\lfloor x\rfloor$，(ii) $\lim_{x\to-2}\lfloor x\rfloor$，(iii) $\lim_{x\to-2.4}\lfloor x\rfloor$。(b) 若 $n$ 为整数，求 (i) $\lim_{x\to n^-}\lfloor x\rfloor$，(ii) $\lim_{x\to n^+}\lfloor x\rfloor$。(c) $a$ 取何值时 $\lim_{x\to a}\lfloor x\rfloor$ 存在？

steps.title: 负数也向下取整 (a.i–ii)
steps.body: 在 $[-2,-1)$ 上，$\lfloor x\rfloor=-2$，故 (i) 为 $-2$。在 $[-3,-2)$ 上，$\lfloor x\rfloor=-3$，所以 $x\to-2$ 的左极限为 $-3$、右极限为 $-2$，(ii) 不存在。

steps.title: 一般整数的左右极限 (b)
steps.body: 在 $n$ 左侧足够近处，$n-1<x<n$，向下取整为 $n-1$；右侧足够近处，$n<x<n+1$，向下取整为 $n$。因此 (i) $n-1$，(ii) $n$。

steps.title: 判断所有 $a$ (c)
steps.body: 每个非整数 $a$ 位于某个 $(k,k+1)$ 内，函数在其邻域恒为 $k$，所以极限存在且为 $\lfloor a\rfloor$。每个整数处左右极限相差 $1$，所以极限不存在。解答图显示这种阶梯结构。

en.prompt: (a) If the symbol $\lfloor\ \rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer function defined in Example 10, evaluate (i) $\lim_{x\to-2^+}\lfloor x\rfloor$, (ii) $\lim_{x\to-2}\lfloor x\rfloor$, and (iii) $\lim_{x\to-2.4}\lfloor x\rfloor$. (b) If $n$ is an integer, evaluate (i) $\lim_{x\to n^-}\lfloor x\rfloor$ and (ii) $\lim_{x\to n^+}\lfloor x\rfloor$. (c) For what values of $a$ does $\lim_{x\to a}\lfloor x\rfloor$ exist?

steps.title: Round downward for negative numbers (a.i–ii)
steps.body: On $[-2,-1)$, $\lfloor x\rfloor=-2$, so (i) is $-2$. On $[-3,-2)$, $\lfloor x\rfloor=-3$. At $-2$ the left limit is $-3$ and the right limit is $-2$, so (ii) does not exist.

steps.title: Use local constancy at a noninteger (a.iii)
steps.body: $-2.4$ lies inside $(-3,-2)$, where the function is constantly $-3$ in a neighborhood. Thus (iii) is $-3$.

steps.title: Find the one-sided limits at an integer (b)
steps.body: Just left of $n$, $n-1<x<n$ and the floor is $n-1$. Just right of $n$, $n<x<n+1$ and the floor is $n$. Therefore (i) is $n-1$ and (ii) is $n$.

steps.title: Classify all $a$ (c)
steps.body: Each noninteger $a$ lies in some $(k,k+1)$, where the function is locally constant at $k$. Its limit exists and equals $\lfloor a\rfloor$. At each integer the one-sided limits differ by $1$, so the limit does not exist. The solution graph shows this staircase structure.

en.answer: (a) (i) $-2$, (ii) does not exist, (iii) $-3$; (b) (i) $n-1$, (ii) $n$; (c) all noninteger $a$.

prompt: 设 $f(x)=\lfloor\cos x\rfloor$，$-\pi\le x\le\pi$。(a) 画出 $f$ 的图像。(b) 求下列极限（若存在）：(i) $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)$，(ii) $\lim_{x\to(\pi/2)^-}f(x)$，(iii) $\lim_{x\to(\pi/2)^+}f(x)$，(iv) $\lim_{x\to\pi/2}f(x)$。(c) $a$ 取何值时 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ 存在？

steps.title: 求 $0$ 处极限 (b.i)
steps.body: 在 $0$ 两侧充分近且 $x\ne0$ 时，$f(x)=0$，所以极限为 $0$。单点函数值 $f(0)=1$ 不影响它。

steps.title: 求 $\pi/2$ 处极限 (b.ii–iv)
steps.body: 从 $\pi/2$ 左侧靠近时，余弦为小正数，取整为 $0$；从右侧靠近时，余弦为小负数，取整为 $-1$。因此 (ii) $0$，(iii) $-1$，(iv) 不存在。

steps.title: 分类所有位置 (c)
steps.body: 在内部点，只有 $a=\pm\pi/2$ 存在跳跃；$a=0$ 虽有孤立点值，极限仍存在。按本节双侧极限的约定，所有 $a\in(-\pi,\pi)\setminus\{-\pi/2,\pi/2\}$ 的极限存在。端点仅有 $\lim_{x\to-\pi^+}f(x)=\lim_{x\to\pi^-}f(x)=-1$，不列为双侧极限。

answer: (a) 图见解析；(b) (i) $0$，(ii) $0$，(iii) $-1$，(iv) 不存在；(c) $a\in(-\pi,\pi)\setminus\{-\pi/2,\pi/2\}$，其中 $a=0$ 包含在内。

en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\lfloor\cos x\rfloor$, $-\pi\le x\le\pi$. (a) Sketch the graph of $f$. (b) Evaluate each limit, if it exists: (i) $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)$; (ii) $\lim_{x\to(\pi/2)^-}f(x)$; (iii) $\lim_{x\to(\pi/2)^+}f(x)$; (iv) $\lim_{x\to\pi/2}f(x)$. (c) For what values of $a$ does $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ exist?

steps.title: Turn the cosine ranges into steps (a)
steps.body: On $[-\pi,-\pi/2)$ and $(\pi/2,\pi]$, $-1\le\cos x<0$, so $f=-1$. On $[-\pi/2,0)$ and $(0,\pi/2]$, $0\le\cos x<1$, so $f=0$. Only at $x=0$ does $\cos0=1$, giving $f(0)=1$. The solution graph marks the open and closed endpoints.

steps.title: Find the limit at $0$ (b.i)
steps.body: For nonzero $x$ sufficiently close to $0$ on either side, $f(x)=0$, so the limit is $0$. The isolated value $f(0)=1$ does not affect it.

steps.title: Find the limits at $\pi/2$ (b.ii–iv)
steps.body: Just left of $\pi/2$, the cosine is a small positive number and its floor is $0$. Just right of $\pi/2$, it is a small negative number and its floor is $-1$. Thus (ii) is $0$, (iii) is $-1$, and (iv) does not exist.

steps.title: Classify the locations (c)
steps.body: Among interior points, only $a=\pm\pi/2$ have jumps. At $a=0$, the isolated function value does not prevent the limit. Under the two-sided convention of this section, the limit exists for all $a\in(-\pi,\pi)\setminus\{-\pi/2,\pi/2\}$. At the endpoints there are only the inward limits $\lim_{x\to-\pi^+}f(x)=\lim_{x\to\pi^-}f(x)=-1$; these are not listed as two-sided limits.

en.answer: (a) See the solution graph; (b) (i) $0$, (ii) $0$, (iii) $-1$, (iv) does not exist; (c) $a\in(-\pi,\pi)\setminus\{-\pi/2,\pi/2\}$, including $a=0$.

prompt: 设 $f(x)=\lfloor x\rfloor+\lfloor-x\rfloor$，证明 $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)$ 存在，但不等于 $f(2)$。

steps.title: 计算单点函数值
steps.body: $f(2)=\lfloor2\rfloor+\lfloor-2\rfloor=2-2=0$。这只说明点上的值，不能直接给出极限。

steps.title: 分别检查左右邻域
steps.body: 若 $1<x<2$，则 $\lfloor x\rfloor=1$、$\lfloor-x\rfloor=-2$，故 $f(x)=-1$。若 $2<x<3$，则两项为 $2$ 与 $-3$，仍有 $f(x)=-1$。

steps.title: 得出双侧极限
steps.body: 左右极限都为 $-1$，因此 $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=-1\ne0=f(2)$。

en.prompt: If $f(x)=\lfloor x\rfloor+\lfloor-x\rfloor$, show that $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)$ exists but is not equal to $f(2)$.

steps.title: Evaluate the function at the point
steps.body: $f(2)=\lfloor2\rfloor+\lfloor-2\rfloor=2-2=0$. This gives the value at the point, not the limit.

steps.title: Check both neighboring intervals
steps.body: If $1<x<2$, then $\lfloor x\rfloor=1$ and $\lfloor-x\rfloor=-2$, so $f(x)=-1$. If $2<x<3$, the terms are $2$ and $-3$, again giving $f(x)=-1$.

steps.title: Conclude the two-sided limit
steps.body: Both one-sided limits equal $-1$, so $\lim_{x\to2}f(x)=-1\ne0=f(2)$.

prompt: 在相对论中，洛伦兹收缩公式 $L=L_0\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}$ 表示物体相对观察者以速度 $v$ 运动时的长度 $L$，其中 $L_0$ 为静止长度，$c$ 为光速。求 $\lim_{v\to c^-}L$ 并解释结果。为什么必须取左极限？

steps.title: 从允许的一侧求极限
steps.body: 取 $L_0>0$、$c>0$ 为常数。当 $v\to c^-$ 时，$u=1-v^2/c^2\to0$ 且保持非负。对任意正数 $\eta$，$0\le u<\eta^2$ 蕴含 $0\le\sqrt{u}<\eta$，所以平方根也趋零。因此 $\lim_{v\to c^-}L=L_0\cdot0=0$。

steps.title: 解释长度和方向
steps.body: 按该公式，当速度从小于光速的一侧趋近光速时，观察到的长度趋于零。若 $v>c$，根号内为负，公式无实数长度值，所以不能从右侧逼近 $c$。

answer: 极限为 $0$；速度从下方趋近光速时，公式中的观察长度趋零。左极限由实数定义域决定。

en.prompt: In the theory of relativity, the Lorentz contraction formula $L=L_0\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}$ expresses the length $L$ of an object as a function of its velocity $v$ with respect to an observer, where $L_0$ is the length of the object at rest and $c$ is the speed of light. Find $\lim_{v\to c^-}L$ and interpret the result. Why is a left-hand limit necessary?

steps.title: Approach from the allowed side
steps.body: Treat $L_0>0$ and $c>0$ as constants. As $v\to c^-$, $u=1-v^2/c^2\to0$ while remaining nonnegative. For any positive $\eta$, $0\le u<\eta^2$ implies $0\le\sqrt{u}<\eta$, so the square root also tends to zero. Thus $\lim_{v\to c^-}L=L_0\cdot0=0$.

steps.title: Interpret the length and direction
steps.body: According to this formula, the observed length approaches zero as the velocity approaches the speed of light from below. If $v>c$, the radicand is negative and the formula gives no real length, so a right-hand approach to $c$ is unavailable.

en.answer: The limit is $0$: the observed length in the formula approaches zero as velocity approaches the speed of light from below. The real domain requires the left-hand limit.

prompt: 若 $p$ 是多项式，证明 $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=p(a)$。

steps.title: 写成有限项之和
steps.body: 设 $p(x)=c_0+c_1x+\cdots+c_nx^n$，系数均为常数。基本极限 $\lim_{x\to a}x=a$ 配合幂定律得到 $\lim_{x\to a}x^k=a^k$（$k\ge1$）。

steps.title: 逐项应用极限定律
steps.body: 常数倍与有限和定律给出 $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=c_0+c_1a+\cdots+c_na^n=p(a)$，对任意实数 $a$ 都成立。

answer: 任意多项式在任意实数 $a$ 处都有 $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=p(a)$。

en.prompt: If $p$ is a polynomial, show that $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=p(a)$.

steps.title: Write a finite sum
steps.body: Let $p(x)=c_0+c_1x+\cdots+c_nx^n$ with constant coefficients. The basic limit $\lim_{x\to a}x=a$ and the power law give $\lim_{x\to a}x^k=a^k$ for $k\ge1$.

steps.title: Apply the laws term by term
steps.body: The constant-multiple and finite-sum laws give $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=c_0+c_1a+\cdots+c_na^n=p(a)$ for every real $a$.

en.answer: For every polynomial and every real $a$, $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=p(a)$.

prompt: 若 $r$ 是有理函数，使用第 55 题证明：对 $r$ 定义域中的每个数 $a$，$\lim_{x\to a}r(x)=r(a)$。

steps.title: 写出分子和分母
steps.body: 设 $r(x)=p(x)/q(x)$，其中 $p,q$ 为多项式。由于 $a$ 在该有理函数定义域中，$q(a)\ne0$。

steps.title: 使用第 55 题和商定律
steps.body: 第 55 题给出 $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=p(a)$ 及 $\lim_{x\to a}q(x)=q(a)\ne0$。于是商定律给出 $\lim_{x\to a}r(x)=p(a)/q(a)=r(a)$。

answer: $\lim_{x\to a}r(x)=r(a)$，条件是 $a$ 在定义域中，即分母 $q(a)\ne0$。

en.prompt: If $r$ is a rational function, use Exercise 55 to show that $\lim_{x\to a}r(x)=r(a)$ for every number $a$ in the domain of $r$.

steps.title: Identify numerator and denominator
steps.body: Write $r(x)=p(x)/q(x)$, where $p$ and $q$ are polynomials. Because $a$ is in the domain of this rational function, $q(a)\ne0$.

steps.title: Use Exercise 55 and the quotient law
steps.body: Exercise 55 gives $\lim_{x\to a}p(x)=p(a)$ and $\lim_{x\to a}q(x)=q(a)\ne0$. The quotient law then gives $\lim_{x\to a}r(x)=p(a)/q(a)=r(a)$.

en.answer: $\lim_{x\to a}r(x)=r(a)$ whenever $a$ is in the domain, meaning $q(a)\ne0$.

prompt: 若 $\lim_{x\to1}\frac{f(x)-8}{x-1}=10$，求 $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)$。

steps.title: 先求乘积再加常数
steps.body: 所给比值极限为有限数 $10$，而 $x-1\to0$。由积定律，$f(x)-8\to10\cdot0=0$；再用和定律得 $f(x)\to8$。无需知道 $f(1)$。

en.prompt: If $\lim_{x\to1}\frac{f(x)-8}{x-1}=10$, find $\lim_{x\to1}f(x)$.

steps.title: Rewrite the unknown function
steps.body: In a punctured neighborhood with $x\ne1$, $f(x)-8=\frac{f(x)-8}{x-1}(x-1)$, so $f(x)=8+\frac{f(x)-8}{x-1}(x-1)$.

steps.title: Take the product limit, then add the constant
steps.body: The given quotient has the finite limit $10$, while $x-1\to0$. The product law gives $f(x)-8\to10\cdot0=0$, and the sum law then gives $f(x)\to8$. The value $f(1)$ is unnecessary.

prompt: 若 $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}{x^2}=5$，求：(a) $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)$；(b) $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}x$。

steps.title: 重写 $f(x)$ (a)
steps.body: 当 $x\ne0$ 时，$f(x)=\frac{f(x)}{x^2}\,x^2$。由积定律，$\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=5\cdot0=0$。

steps.title: 重写另一个商 (b)
steps.body: 当 $x\ne0$ 时，$\frac{f(x)}x=\frac{f(x)}{x^2}\,x$。两个因子都有有限极限，因此 $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}x=5\cdot0=0$。

en.prompt: If $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}{x^2}=5$, find the following limits: (a) $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)$; (b) $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}x$.

steps.title: Rewrite $f(x)$ (a)
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $f(x)=\frac{f(x)}{x^2}\,x^2$. The product law gives $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=5\cdot0=0$.

steps.title: Rewrite the other quotient (b)
steps.body: For $x\ne0$, $\frac{f(x)}x=\frac{f(x)}{x^2}\,x$. Both factors have finite limits, so $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x)}x=5\cdot0=0$.

prompt: 设 $f(x)=x^2$（$x$ 为有理数），$f(x)=0$（$x$ 为无理数）。证明 $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=0$。

steps.title: 对两种数统一建立界
steps.body: 有理数处 $f(x)=x^2\ge0$；无理数处 $f(x)=0\le x^2$。因此无论 $x$ 属于哪一种数，都有 $0\le f(x)\le x^2$。

steps.title: 使用夹逼定理
steps.body: 当 $x\to0$ 时，常数下界 $0$ 与上界 $x^2$ 都趋于 $0$，故 $f(x)$ 的极限为 $0$。

en.prompt: If $f(x)=x^2$ if $x$ is rational and $f(x)=0$ if $x$ is irrational, prove that $\lim_{x\to0}f(x)=0$.

steps.title: Use bounds valid for both kinds of numbers
steps.body: At rational numbers, $f(x)=x^2\ge0$. At irrational numbers, $f(x)=0\le x^2$. Thus $0\le f(x)\le x^2$ for every real $x$, regardless of its type.

steps.title: Apply the Squeeze Theorem
steps.body: As $x\to0$, the constant lower bound $0$ and the upper bound $x^2$ both tend to $0$. Therefore $f(x)$ has limit $0$.

prompt: 举例说明：即使 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ 与 $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)$ 都不存在，$\lim_{x\to a}[f(x)+g(x)]$ 仍可能存在。

steps.title: 选择相反的跳跃函数
steps.body: 取 $a=0$，令 $f(x)=\operatorname{sgn}x$，$g(x)=-\operatorname{sgn}x$。两者在 $0$ 处也定义为 $0$。

steps.title: 验证两个单独极限不存在
steps.body: $f$ 的左、右极限分别为 $-1,1$；$g$ 的左、右极限分别为 $1,-1$。因此两者的双侧极限都不存在。

steps.title: 验证和的极限
steps.body: 对所有 $x$，$f(x)+g(x)=0$，所以和的极限为 $0$。和的极限定律需要两个单独极限存在；本例说明其逆命题不成立。

answer: 例如 $a=0$、$f=\operatorname{sgn}x$、$g=-\operatorname{sgn}x$；各自极限不存在，但和的极限为 $0$。

en.prompt: Show by means of an example that $\lim_{x\to a}[f(x)+g(x)]$ may exist even though neither $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ nor $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)$ exists.

steps.title: Choose opposite jump functions
steps.body: Take $a=0$, $f(x)=\operatorname{sgn}x$, and $g(x)=-\operatorname{sgn}x$. Define both values at $0$ to be $0$.

steps.title: Check the individual limits
steps.body: The left and right limits of $f$ are $-1$ and $1$, while those of $g$ are $1$ and $-1$. Thus neither function has a two-sided limit.

steps.title: Check the sum limit
steps.body: For every $x$, $f(x)+g(x)=0$, so the sum has limit $0$. The sum law assumes the individual limits exist; this example shows that its converse fails.

en.answer: For example, take $a=0$, $f=\operatorname{sgn}x$, and $g=-\operatorname{sgn}x$. Neither individual limit exists, but the sum has limit $0$.

prompt: 举例说明：即使 $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ 与 $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)$ 都不存在，$\lim_{x\to a}[f(x)g(x)]$ 仍可能存在。

steps.title: 选择同一个符号函数
steps.body: 取 $a=0$，令 $f(x)=g(x)=\operatorname{sgn}x$。当 $x<0$ 时二者均为 $-1$；当 $x>0$ 时二者均为 $1$。

steps.title: 验证个体与乘积
steps.body: 每个函数的左右极限不同，故均无双侧极限。然而对 $x\ne0$，$f(x)g(x)=(\operatorname{sgn}x)^2=1$，故乘积极限为 $1$。原点乘积值为 $0$ 不影响极限。

answer: 例如 $a=0$、$f=g=\operatorname{sgn}x$；各自极限不存在，但乘积极限为 $1$。

en.prompt: Show by means of an example that $\lim_{x\to a}[f(x)g(x)]$ may exist even though neither $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)$ nor $\lim_{x\to a}g(x)$ exists.

steps.title: Choose the same sign function twice
steps.body: Take $a=0$ and $f(x)=g(x)=\operatorname{sgn}x$. Both equal $-1$ for $x<0$ and $1$ for $x>0$.

steps.title: Check the factors and product
steps.body: Each function has different one-sided limits, so neither has a two-sided limit. However, for $x\ne0$, $f(x)g(x)=(\operatorname{sgn}x)^2=1$, so the product limit is $1$. The product value $0$ at the origin does not affect that limit.

en.answer: For example, take $a=0$ and $f=g=\operatorname{sgn}x$. Neither individual limit exists, but their product has limit $1$.

prompt: 求 $\lim_{x\to2}\frac{\sqrt{6-x}-2}{\sqrt{3-x}-1}$。

steps.title: 识别 $0/0$ 并对两个根式有理化
steps.body: 直接代入得 $0/0$。在 $x\le3$ 且 $x\ne2$ 的邻域内，$\sqrt{6-x}-2=\frac{2-x}{\sqrt{6-x}+2}$，$\sqrt{3-x}-1=\frac{2-x}{\sqrt{3-x}+1}$。

steps.title: 相除并约去共同因子
steps.body: 所以 $\frac{\sqrt{6-x}-2}{\sqrt{3-x}-1}=\frac{2-x}{\sqrt{6-x}+2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3-x}+1}{2-x}=\frac{\sqrt{3-x}+1}{\sqrt{6-x}+2}$。约分只用于 $x\ne2$。

steps.title: 代入化简后的式子
steps.body: 新分母趋于 $\sqrt4+2=4\ne0$，因此极限为 $(\sqrt1+1)/(\sqrt4+2)=2/4=1/2$。

en.prompt: Evaluate $\lim_{x\to2}\frac{\sqrt{6-x}-2}{\sqrt{3-x}-1}$.

steps.title: Identify $0/0$ and rationalize both differences
steps.body: Direct substitution gives $0/0$. In a neighborhood with $x\le3$ and $x\ne2$, $\sqrt{6-x}-2=\frac{2-x}{\sqrt{6-x}+2}$ and $\sqrt{3-x}-1=\frac{2-x}{\sqrt{3-x}+1}$.

steps.title: Divide and cancel the common factor
steps.body: Thus $\frac{\sqrt{6-x}-2}{\sqrt{3-x}-1}=\frac{2-x}{\sqrt{6-x}+2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3-x}+1}{2-x}=\frac{\sqrt{3-x}+1}{\sqrt{6-x}+2}$. The cancellation is used only for $x\ne2$.

steps.title: Substitute into the simplified expression
steps.body: The new denominator tends to $\sqrt4+2=4\ne0$. Hence the limit is $(\sqrt1+1)/(\sqrt4+2)=2/4=1/2$.

prompt: 是否存在数 $a$，使 $\lim_{x\to-2}\frac{3x^2+ax+a+3}{x^2+x-2}$ 存在？若存在，求 $a$ 与极限值。

steps.title: 建立必要条件
steps.body: 分母为 $(x+2)(x-1)$，当 $x\to-2$ 时趋零。若商有有限极限，则分子作为商与分母的乘积也必须趋零。分子极限为 $12-2a+a+3=15-a$，故必须 $a=15$。

steps.title: 求极限并说明唯一性
steps.body: 代入得 $3(-2+3)/(-2-1)=-1$。必要条件只给出一个 $a$，且已验证该值有效，因此 $a=15$ 是唯一答案。

answer: 存在，唯一为 $a=15$，此时极限为 $-1$。

en.prompt: Is there a number $a$ such that $\lim_{x\to-2}\frac{3x^2+ax+a+3}{x^2+x-2}$ exists? If so, find the value of $a$ and the value of the limit.

steps.title: Derive a necessary condition
steps.body: The denominator is $(x+2)(x-1)$ and tends to zero as $x\to-2$. If the quotient has a finite limit, its numerator, as the quotient times the denominator, must also tend to zero. The numerator limit is $12-2a+a+3=15-a$, so $a=15$ is necessary.

steps.title: Verify that the condition is sufficient
steps.body: For $a=15$, the numerator is $3x^2+15x+18=3(x+2)(x+3)$. For $x\ne-2$ in a neighborhood of $-2$ chosen to exclude $1$, the quotient becomes $3(x+3)/(x-1)$, whose denominator is nonzero at $-2$.

steps.title: Evaluate the limit and establish uniqueness
steps.body: Substitution gives $3(-2+3)/(-2-1)=-1$. The necessary condition yields only one value of $a$, and it has been verified, so $a=15$ is the unique answer.

en.answer: Yes: uniquely $a=15$, and the limit is $-1$.

prompt: 图中固定圆 $C_1$ 的方程为 $(x-1)^2+y^2=1$；圆 $C_2$ 以原点为圆心、半径为 $r$，并不断缩小。$P=(0,r)$，$Q$ 为两圆上方的交点，$R$ 为直线 $PQ$ 与 $x$ 轴的交点。当 $C_2$ 缩小，即 $r\to0^+$ 时，$R$ 会怎样变化？

steps.title: 取 $r\to0^+$ 并解释位置
steps.body: 因此 $\lim_{r\to0^+}x_R=2(1+1)=4$，纵坐标始终为 $0$。当 $r$ 缩小时，根号增大，$x_R$ 从小于 $4$ 的位置增大趋近 $4$；所以 $R$ 沿 $x$ 轴趋向 $(4,0)$，而不是原点。

en.prompt: The figure shows a fixed circle $C_1$ with equation $(x-1)^2+y^2=1$ and a shrinking circle $C_2$ with radius $r$ and center the origin. $P$ is the point $(0,r)$, $Q$ is the upper point of intersection of the two circles, and $R$ is the point of intersection of the line $PQ$ and the $x$-axis. What happens to $R$ as $C_2$ shrinks, that is, as $r\to0^+$?

steps.title: Find $Q$ from the two circle equations
steps.body: $C_2$ has equation $x^2+y^2=r^2$, and expanding $C_1$ gives $x^2+y^2=2x$. Hence $x_Q=r^2/2$. Substitution into $C_2$, taking the positive $y$, gives $y_Q=r\sqrt{1-r^2/4}$. For $0<r<2$ the upper intersection exists, so $P=(0,r)$ and $Q=(r^2/2,r\sqrt{1-r^2/4})$.

steps.title: Find the slope and intercept
steps.body: Let $s=\sqrt{1-r^2/4}$. The slope of $PQ$ is $m=(rs-r)/(r^2/2)=2(s-1)/r<0$, and its equation is $y=r+mx$. Setting $y=0$ gives $x_R=-r/m=r^2/[2(1-s)]$, so $R=(r^2/[2(1-s)],0)$.

steps.title: Rationalize the intercept
steps.body: Multiply by the conjugate to obtain $x_R=\frac{r^2(1+s)}{2(1-s^2)}$. Since $1-s^2=r^2/4$ and $r>0$, cancellation gives $x_R=2(1+\sqrt{1-r^2/4})$.

steps.title: Take $r\to0^+$ and interpret the position
steps.body: Thus $\lim_{r\to0^+}x_R=2(1+1)=4$, while the vertical coordinate remains $0$. As $r$ decreases, the square root increases and $x_R$ approaches $4$ from below. Hence $R$ moves along the $x$-axis toward $(4,0)$ rather than the origin.
